Quantized model accuracy collapse Calibration data is not representative, per-channel quantization is disabled for CNNs, or asymmetric scheme is used on an accelerator that requires symmetric. Use 100-300 representative samples; enable per_channel=True for CNN/Linear layers; switch to symmetric quantization for QNN/CoreML; evaluate with a held-out set. accuracy drop perplexity accuracy collapsed INT8 accuracy quantized model is wrong

Out of memory during quantization or tuning Calibration batch or intermediate tensors exceed GPU memory. LoRA target modules not found target_modules do not match the model architecture (e.g. using q_proj/v_proj for a BERT model). TensorRT engine build is very slow or fails INT8 TensorRT requires per-engine calibration and explicit QDQ placement; dynamic shapes enlarge the search space. Use static shapes where possible; pre-generate calibration cache; enable OnnxStaticQuantization with QDQ format before TensorRT; reuse engine files. TensorRT tensorrt engine build trt build time

AWQ calibration is slow or hangs AWQ scans weights and activations; large models or large calibration sets take time. Reduce calibration iters to 32; use a small subset (128 samples); ensure GPU memory is available. AWQ nvidia-modelopt awq calibration activation-aware

QNN reports unsupported operator Qualcomm QNN has a limited op whitelist; LayerNorm and GELU are often unsupported. Run QNNPreprocess before QNNQuantization; use OnnxModelOptimizer to fuse LayerNorm; consider replacing GELU with approximate ops if the model allows. QNN not supported unsupported op LayerNormalization GELU

CoreML conversion fails with dynamic shapes CoreML prefers fixed input shapes; dynamic batch or sequence length can fail. Fix input shapes by removing dynamic_axes in OnnxConversion; use symbolic shape inference carefully. CoreML dynamic shape flexible shape input shape

LoRA adapter cannot be merged into quantized base Merging adapters into a 4-bit or quantized base model is not supported by Olive. Merge LoRA weights into the full-precision base model before ONNX conversion; then quantize the merged ONNX model. LoRA merge adapter base model merge_weights

OpenVINO silently falls back to CPU EP OpenVINO Execution Provider does not support some ops or data types. Check OpenVINO operator support; use OnnxModelOptimizer to fuse unsupported patterns; convert to OpenVINO IR for broader op support. OpenVINO fallback CPUExecutionProvider not supported

Transformer optimization fails due to missing dims OrtTransformersOptimization needs num_heads and hidden_size for attention fusion. Set num_heads and hidden_size in pass params; verify against model config. OrtTransformersOptimization num_heads hidden_size fusion

INT4 quantization causes large perplexity increase INT4 weight quantization is aggressive; small models or sensitive layers suffer. Use group size 128 or 64; exclude lm_head and embedding layers from quantization; try AWQ or GPTQ with larger group size. int4 perplexity quality degradation

FP16 conversion produces NaN/Inf Model activations exceed FP16 range or are not trained for FP16. Keep I/O types float32; cast int inputs to int32; exclude sensitive ops from FP16; consider mixed precision. FP16 NaN inf OnnxFloatToFloat16 overflow

Calibration data distribution mismatch Calibration samples do not match inference inputs; quantization scale/zp are wrong. Use production-like data; cover min/max sequence lengths and vocabulary; avoid synthetic or unrelated samples. calibration distribution domain shift accuracy

HuggingFace model fails to load after upgrading to olive-ai 0.13.0 Olive 0.13.0 changed the default value of trust_remote_code from true to false for security. Models with custom code (e.g., Phi, Mistral with custom RoPE, Qwen) now refuse to load unless explicitly opted in. In Olive Studio, open the Hugging Face source settings and enable Trust Remote Code. Enabling this executes Python from the model repository inside the Olive process on your machine, so only enable it for repositories you trust. QairtPreparation or QairtGenAIBuilder pass not found in olive-ai 0.13.0 The QairtPreparation and QairtGenAIBuilder passes were superseded by the unified QairtPipeline pass in olive-ai 0.13.0. Recipes referencing the old pass names will fail. Replace QairtPreparation and QairtGenAIBuilder with a single QairtPipeline pass. QairtPipeline combines model loading, quantization, and compilation into one YAML-recipe-driven step.
